title: LFM2 admitted to batched prefill with no conv mixer; panics
reason: canBatchN's hand-listed own-forward exclusions omit lfm2, so the batched path treats it as a default dense family and nil-indexes its absent weights.

title: LFM2 conv window unknown to every recurrent-state lifecycle predicate
reason: A new recurrent state kind (conv window) is absent from TruncateTo/reconcile/specRollbackSafe/Snapshot/capture guards, which treat it as positional KV.

title: LFM2 .giw written without conv weights; loads clean then nil-derefs
reason: The .giw writer/reader has no branch for lfm2's shortConv field, so the family serializes as if it had none; census fixture list also missed it.

title: Batched prefill tile exceeds pool slot on warm sliding-window session
reason: Path handles ring layers but computes the tile from per-layer keys while slots are sized from global keys; dynamic sizing mismatch, not a fixed limit (N vs B).

title: Cancelled prefill on wrapped ring leaves stale K/V; reconcile ignores exact
reason: reconcile's rollback guard knows only mamba/delta state; a wrapped ring's inexact rewind is treated as the exact default case and kept warm (R vs O).
option_or_family: wrapped sliding-window ring after mid-sweep cancel

title: Heartbeat goroutine and handler race on the same ResponseWriter
reason: A data race between two writers, not caused by an unregistered option/family/state or an unchecked limit.

title: Decoder-as-embedder has no MaxPositions bound on input tokens
reason: The model's max-positions cap exists but the embedder never checks tokens against it; byte cap admits ~500k positions.

title: Unbounded top_logprobs allocates max_tokens x top_logprobs entries
reason: Unvalidated request field allocating proportional memory; the code holds no limit at all, so O not B.

title: Paged gpt-oss on Metal applies expert 0's biases to every expert
reason: The paged path knows about gpt-oss biases but indexes the expert-major bias table with the zeroed slot index: wrong buffer offset.

title: Byte-level pre-tokenizer applies one regex shape to every family
reason: Unrecognized pre names and regex shapes fall to a silent cl100k default instead of a matching walker or a named decline.

title: Block-spec generate ignores StopIDs and generation_config EOS ids
reason: The block-spec loop never receives SamplingParams.StopIDs and rebuilds stops from config.json only, treating every request as having no extra stops (R vs N).

title: Block-spec seed materializes MxVocab logits; grow-only buffer leaks
reason: Wasted head compute, GB-scale VRAM/host allocation and an abandoned buffer: performance and leak, no registration or bound miss.

title: gate gpu prints PASS for Metal groups running zero tests
reason: A release gate counts all-skip cells as passes; the defect is in the gate, not product code.

title: No ritual or CI cell compiles the tagged Metal parity tests
reason: The release ritual and CI never build the goinfer_testhooks Metal tests they vouch for.

title: Metal cgo-free check builds the root serve, not metal/cmd/serve
reason: A gate check targets the wrong binary, so it passes regardless of the Metal entrypoint.

title: Five required sweep gates stuck FIRST-RUN, so failures cannot block
reason: Gate ledger never promoted confirmed passes, so required gates are non-blocking; defect in release gating.

title: Release sweep discards FAIL counts; unlisted and unreachable gates
reason: Sweep blocks only on a hand-written 55-name checkset and a hand-written realckpt -run, omitting many family parity gates.

title: ForwardN parity test checks cosine 0.99 on a bit-identity contract
reason: A test asserts a weaker bar than the documented bit-identity and carries a stale comment.

title: Expert-cache A/B test's slot request silently floored to nE
reason: The test's stated configuration is not the one that runs and nothing asserts the effective slot count.

title: Batched-verify kernel parity test dispatches with stale argument lists
reason: The evidence test binds too few buffers, so it cannot check the bit-identity it is cited for.

title: WebGPU absent from gate gpu; its parity gates opt-in only
reason: Gate's backend detection enumerates cuda|metal|none only, so the WebGPU backend's gates never run.

title: Three smaller vacuous tests: API-tiers substring, zero-assert, log-only
reason: Dominant: API-tiers doc check matches by substring and cannot fail; also TokenText passes with zero assertions and log-only Test* harnesses.

title: ResidentWeightBytes omits whole family-specific tensor classes
reason: The byte accountant visits generic fields only; gemma4moe, delta/qattn, mamba, mla, shortConv and PLE fields are unregistered, so the guard under-counts.
option_or_family: Gemma-4 MoE, Qwen3.5, Mamba-2, MLA, LFM2 conv, PLE tables

title: Metal memory guard ignores MoE slot budget and host copy
reason: The guard never consults GOINFER_METAL_MOE_SLOTS, judging paged models as fully resident; the uncounted host copy is secondary sizing (R vs N).

title: P19 allocates unused fused scratch per slot, layer, decoded token
reason: Per-token allocation churn on a path that never reads it; a performance defect.

title: LoadSession skips length checks; numLayers=0 bypasses allocation bound
reason: Untrusted snapshot blob lengths are unvalidated and the header bound is computed from blob dims; input validation/security (O vs B for the bypassed bound).

title: Llama-4 attention_chunk_size read from config, never applied
reason: The chunk-size config value is dropped by the adapter, so RoPE layers treat it as the default full-causal case (R vs B position cap).

title: validateResolved misses zero RoPE base, NaN/Inf scale, zero dims
reason: The chokepoint guard does not know these config values, so a zero base falls to the no-RoPE default silently (R vs O validation).
option_or_family: zero RoPE base, NaN/+Inf AttnScale, zero dims

title: EAGLE prefill ignores cpu-fast-attention; docs promise exact reuse
reason: EAGLE's prefill never consults the fast-attention option that prefillLogits honours; doc and missing-test claims are secondary G parts (R vs G).

title: MinP above 1 empties candidates and panics in sampler
reason: Sampler handles min-p but its keep-top-token clamp indexes an empty set at -1; arguably O unvalidated parameter (N vs O).

title: StreamTranscodeGGUF writes header-only bundle for five families
reason: Five families' GGUF branches never drive the sink yet are admitted to streaming as default; fix names them (needsResidentSerialize).

title: Unbounded layer-count allocations from untrusted GGUF and .giw metadata
reason: Layer-count ceilings exist (ggufLayerCount, maxSerializedLayers) but laguna skips one and resolveArchitecture runs before the other (B vs R for laguna).

title: validateShapes skips v2/v4/v6 tail tensors; absent vectors panic
reason: Family-specific tail fields (AttnSinks, biases, mla, mamba, delta, PLE) are absent from the shape guard, which treats absence as allowed.
option_or_family: gpt-oss AttnSinks/biases, MLA, Mamba-2, DeltaNet, PLE fields

title: Stream-weights sidecar written in place, freshness by mtime only
reason: Non-atomic write and mtime-only cache freshness: file/lifecycle mechanics, not a registration, bound or numeric miss.

title: BlockSpec overshoots MaxTokens and errors near context cap
reason: Each round's burst is never clamped to remaining MaxTokens or the resident context cap; telemetry and cancel parts are secondary.

title: CUDA verifyTheta assumes batched verify for sequential-fallback models
reason: verifyTheta keys on backend name, treating MoE/K=V/non-int4 models as the batched default; consequence is speed (R vs O perf).
option_or_family: MoE / K=V / non-uniform / non-int4 CUDA residents

title: CUDA drafter K/V capacity frozen at prompt+512 tokens
reason: A fixed drafter K/V capacity is exceeded by longer generations and only errors mid-stream (B vs N sizing).

title: Single-block attention shared memory exceeds 48 KB past 12k keys
reason: Dynamic shared-memory request grows with keys and nothing compares it to the device per-block limit.
option_or_family: 48 KB dynamic shared memory per block

title: Non-reading SSE client pins the single decode worker
reason: Missing per-write deadline lets a stalled client hold the worker: resource exhaustion, no limit held.

title: /v1/responses turns function_call items into empty user turns
reason: The item decoder ignores the type discriminator, treating function_call/function_call_output as the default role/content message (R vs O missing feature).
option_or_family: Responses input item types function_call / function_call_output

title: Anthropic tool streaming lacks heartbeat at third buffer site
reason: A serving robustness gap at one route; routes are not option/family/state, so not R.

title: Gemma 4 tool render/parse disagrees with template; nested args broken
reason: Path handles Gemma-4 tools but renders wrong turn scaffolding and mis-serializes/parses nested values; the unread fixture is a secondary G part.

title: Five routes tokenize arbitrary bodies before the size guard
reason: Pre-tokenization guard missing on routes: request validation/resource exhaustion, not option/family/state.

title: Vision path bypasses special-token hardening; user text forges turns
reason: Prompt-injection security defect on a route that skipped segment encoding.

title: Graceful shutdown returns truncated generations as clean stop
reason: Cancel-cause classification error; shutdown is an event source rather than an option/family/state kind (O vs R).

title: Losing concurrent admin load leaks fully loaded model
reason: Resource leak on a refusal path.

title: /v1/completions drops leading space on dummy-prefix tokenizers
reason: Decode path applies the sequence-level dummy-prefix strip to a continuation: wrong output from a handled path (N vs R).

title: include_usage honoured only on plain chat stream
reason: Tool and vision streams and /v1/completions never consult stream_options.include_usage, treating every request as the default no-usage case.

title: StopWhenComplete truncates numbers at first completion point
reason: The masker reads a may-end predicate as must-end, cutting legal multi-digit scalars: wrong logic in a handled path.

title: SchemaFromStruct mishandles embedded structs, Unmarshalers, sized ints
reason: Reflection builds wrong schemas for embedded fields and Unmarshaler types; the false 'always succeeds' doc claim is secondary (N vs G).

title: Enum/const literals HTML-escaped; large integer enums lose precision
reason: Literal encoding computes the wrong bytes (HTML escaping, float64 round-trip) in a path that handles enums.

title: Empty-properties no-arg tool schema rejected with 400
reason: API-shape gap in tool schema handling; a schema spelling is not an option/family/state.

title: WebGPU runtime declines at 256 experts while cap says 512
reason: A restated 256-expert limit disagrees with the declared 512 cap that admission checks; stale-limit inconsistency (B vs G for blind pin tests).

title: --kv i8/f16 ignored by DeltaNet/Nemotron/MLA KV; -ctx ignored
reason: Family-specific KV branches never consult the KV precision flag while kernels switch model-wide; WebGPU also ignores -ctx.

title: Releases embed Qwen weights without license, NOTICE, or digest
reason: Release mechanics and licensing/supply-chain gaps dominate; the false NOTICE sentence is a secondary G part (O vs G).

title: RELEASING.md cites a nonexistent CI standalone-build gate
reason: A release doc claims a CI gate that does not exist, and demo/agent has no CI job.

title: moe.ptx regenerated off-pin while docs and lint claim audited
reason: Comments, REGEN.md and the FMA-lint exemption claim a frozen audited artifact that no longer exists.
